title: Leaf Studio
method: Native SVG geometry; semantic stem, leaves, veins and identity accents.
limitations: Original demonstration identity, not commissioned client work. No automatic tracing is involved.

notes: Four leaf silhouettes, stem, pale veins and gold accents match the original SVG in shape, scale, placement and final colors. The source and final comparison panels are pixel-identical.

Inspected actual offline Chromium source/drawing/final preview plus opening/middle/final on light, dark and checkerboard backgrounds. Opening is blank without added blue decoration; exterior transparency and source-colored interior areas are preserved.
Inspected decoded GIF opening, drawing and final frames: 480x360, 41 stored frames, 4800 ms including final hold. The declared #F6F4EC GIF matte is opaque, while HTML and PNG retain exterior alpha.
Original outline colors are retained. Dark source outlines have lower contrast on dark test surfaces; the supplied light matte provides the intended presentation contrast.
